questions.text: What should the frame counter count, how wide should it be, and when should it reset?
questions.default: Use a 32-bit unsigned counter that increments once per completed video frame, wraps on overflow, and starts at zero after power-up.
questions.reason: The specification requires a readable frame counter but does not define its width, increment event, wrap behaviour, or initial value.
questions.answer: Use a 32-bit unsigned counter that increments once per completed video frame, wraps on overflow, and starts at zero after power-up.
